image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a white baby bib with a green tropical leaf pattern (monstera/palm). The bib features a white crocheted or lace trim along the curved edges and neck opening. A white fabric tie is visible at the top center of the neck opening, and another tie hangs loosely on the left side. The material appears to be a soft fabric, likely cotton or a blend, rather than glossy plastic.
